crossRefs.note: That servant, who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare, nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,
but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given…
Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.
If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things…
Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and…
who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but…
Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,
Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was…

translations.web: To him therefore who knows to do good, and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.
translations.bsb: Anyone, then, who knows the right thing to do, yet fails to do it, is guilty of sin.
translations.kjv: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
translations.asv: To him therefore that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
